tbesh_html:
1) to swallow down, swallow up, engulf, eat up
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to swallow down
1a2) to swallow up, engulf
1b) (Niphal) to be swallowed up
1c) (Piel)
1c1) to swallow
1c2) to swallow up, engulf
1c3) squandering (fig.)
1d) (Pual) to be swallowed up
1e) (Hithpael) to be ended

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy
strongs_1890.kjv_def: cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).
